steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow used by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title for the create flow.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product and quantity; the product's configured variant should populate automatically.

args.goal: On the current RFQ pricing screen, open the currency or exchange-rate editor, add USD with exchange rate -1, attempt to save it, and stop when the screen shows the refusal message "All exchange rates must be positive numbers".

steps.note: No catalog domain step operates the currency exchange-rate editor, so perform the buyer-side UI interaction directly and require the stated refusal.
